title: Automate Reauthorization Fails with "project_id should not be empty" Error
alternate_search_terms: project_id should not be empty error
HTTP 400 Bad Request Automate connected app

extracted_facts.problem: Reauthorizing an existing Contentstack connected app in Automate (Agent OS) returns a "project_id should not be empty" HTTP 400 Bad Request error, which prevents creating new automations using the Contentstack connector with workflow access.
resolution_steps: Create a new Contentstack connection instead of reauthorizing the existing one, either from Settings → Connected Apps or by selecting "Add new account" within the automation step.
Grant the required permissions during the initial authorization of the new connection.
